# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch contains several hundred short call snippets, of which a genuine sales/enquiry core of roughly 60–80 calls is usable (many others are duplicated audio files, internal loading/vehicle coordination, Porter/driver cancellation chatter, or near-silent clips). The real sales calls are almost entirely **rate-enquiry and order-processing calls** for **color-coated steel roofing sheets (GI/GL/PPGL/PPGI)**, with a smaller volume of calls on **PUF (puff) insulated panels, screws/fasteners, structural pipes (square/round), polycarbonate sheets, and flashing/ridge/gutter accessories**. There is no roofing-installation/fixing business — the company states repeatedly "material supply மட்டும்தான், fixing/fabrication நம்மளது கிடையாது." Given the repetitive, short, transactional nature of most calls, this KB stays grounded strictly in what was said — it is not a deep enterprise playbook but a distilled pattern-set from real counter/phone conversations.

## Products & brand ladder

**Primary product: Color-coated roofing sheets (steel, GI/GL base)**
- Brands mentioned, roughly ladder-ordered by what reps describe as premium → economy:
  - **JSW Coloron Plus** — flagship brand, thickness 0.47mm / 0.50mm / 0.60mm, colors Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite/Pencil Grey, Royal Blue, Nova Blue, Mist Green, Bare (non-color)
  - **JSW Pragathi** — mid brand, frequently quoted, price fluctuates most (405→475+GST across calls, attributed to raw-material inflation)
  - **Radiance, Kalaran, Kalavan Plus, L Plus** — other JSW-family variants, generally priced above Pragathi, below Coloron Plus top grades
  - **Asian Indradhanush** — economy brand, 0.45mm thickness, only Sky Blue / Half White, PPGI (not PPGL) — "0.45-னா Indradhanush brand தான் வரும்... PPGI-ல வரும், PPGL-ல வராது."
  - **Steel Bare / Silver On** — uncoated silver sheet, cheaper, used for tenders ("steel bar இப்போ stock கம்மியா இருக்கும்... coil வந்தா மட்டும்தான் இப்போ இருக்கற price-ல கொடுக்க முடியும்")
  - Competitor brands customers ask about but NOT stocked: **Apollo, Tata Bluescope, Saint-Gobain** ("நம்மகிட்ட வேற எந்த brand-உம் இல்ல JSW மட்டும்தான்")

**Secondary products:**
- **PUF/Puff sandwich panels** — 30/40/50mm thickness, top & bottom metal skin with foam core, used for roofing/wall insulation; company explicitly does NOT fabricate/fix, only supplies ("insulation பண்ண மாட்டோம்")
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — blue, thickness in mm (2mm standard; 1.8mm thinner option exists; 3mm not regularly stocked)
- **Decking sheet / Profile sheet** — JSW make, GSL variants
- **Structural pipes** — square pipe & round pipe, various sizes/thicknesses (1.6/2/3mm)
- **Accessories** — Ridge, ridge cap, L-flashing, rain/flash cutter, down pipe, gutter (e.g. 150x75mm), deep trim — pricing depends on width (below/above 610mm) and is "as per diagram," not standard catalog
- **Fasteners** — Tata-brand self-drilling/stitching screws (various sizes: 19mm, 25mm, 1 inch, 1.5 inch, 5.5 inch "wedge" screws), Tata welding electrodes, cutting/grinding wheels
